card.name: Words leading into visual inspection
card.fires_on: Small words or word parts just before a visual-check phrase, such as 'by' before inspecting or squeezing, or 'unsightly' and 'visually'. Mostly in device and IV-bag handling steps.

modes.label: Check-by-looking step
modes.description: A linking word right before an instruction to look at or inspect something such as a bag, cannula or solution.
